blocks.title: Plans
blocks.lead: Tessera is free through December 31, 2026. From January 1, 2027, it takes a key on one of three plans. Each plan raises the same four things: requests, storage, worker hours on Meta's Muse models, and support.

items.name: Free through Dec 31, 2026
items.for: Trying Tessera, with no account and no key.

values.storage: 1 MB per session, deleted after 24 hours

items.name: Developer
items.for: One developer, or a small project.

items.name: Team
items.for: A team running agents every day.

values.requests: More than Developer, shared across your team's keys

items.name: Enterprise
items.for: Larger systems with their own needs.

blocks.heading: Good to know
paragraphs: Every plan uses the same Tessera: the same queues, storage, model shim and workers. Plans differ in how much you can use, and in the support you get.
There's no checkout or sign-up on this site. To start a plan, [write to us](/company/#contact) and we'll reply with a price.
Eranos stays free for nonprofits and volunteers.
